..Title
Resolution to Approve Jefferson Townhomes Development Agreement, 318 East Jefferson Street (Planning Manager Recommendation: Approval)
..Memorandum
This resolution will approve a development agreement between the City of Ann Arbor and Deinco Properties, the developer of a site planned project to construct six residential units and a shared driveway.

The zoning designation is R4C (Multiple-Family Dwelling District). 

The development agreement specifies requirements associated with the approved Jefferson Townhomes Site Plan, including construction of public water main, private storm water management system, public street, public sidewalk, and private sidewalk and contributing $3,750.00 to the City Parks and Recreation Services for improvements to surrounding and community parks. The Planning Manager has approved the associated Site Plan and recommended approval.  

Attachments:	318 E Jefferson Approval Letter
	Development Agreement 
..Staff
Prepared By:	Mariana Melin-Corcoran, City Planner
Reviewed By:	Brett Lenart, Planning Manager 
	Derek Delacourt, Community Services Area Administrator
Approved By:	Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, The Jefferson Townhomes Site Plan was approved by the Planning Manager on June 16, 2025 in order to develop six residential units and a shared driveway; and

Whereas, A development agreement has been prepared to address construction of public water main, private storm water management system, public street, public sidewalk, and private sidewalk and contributing $3,750.00 to the City Parks and Recreation Services for improvements to surrounding and community parks;

RESOLVED, That City Council approves the development agreement, substantially in the form of that attached; 

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized and directed to sign the Jefferson Townhouses Development Agreement after approval by the City Administrator and City Attorney; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take the necessary actions to implement this resolution.
